paper_title: Spectral Editing of Activations for Large Language Model Alignment
caption: MC1 scores of SEA by using a different number of demonstrations. A higher score indicates a better performance. We find that SEA can start to positively improve the baseline with only 25 demonstrations on both TruthfulQA and BBQ for the 7B LLaMA-2-Chat model.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the accuracy scores achieved by three different alignment methods—Squared Exponential, Truth, and LLAMA-2-chat-7B—as the number of demonstrations increases from 0 to 1500. The x-axis, labeled “#Demonstrations,” uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1500, with tick labels appearing at intervals of 250. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy,” uses a linear scale ranging from 45 to 55, with tick marks appearing at intervals of 5. The “Squared Exponential” method is represented by a solid dark blue line with circular markers, starting at an accuracy of approximately 53 and rising to about 55 before leveling off. The “Truth” method is shown as a dashed dark blue line with circular markers, beginning at around 47 and remaining relatively flat near 48 throughout the range. The “LLaMA-2-chat-7B” method is depicted by a dotted pink line with circular markers, maintaining a constant accuracy of approximately 46 across the entire demonstration range.
